# clavis members mark-safe

<p class="cli-lead">Mark a secret the member saw as safe to keep</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis members mark-safe USER TASK_ID
```

</div>

Close an offboarding task without rotating, for a secret that doesn't need it.

## Examples

```sh
clavis members mark-safe ada@example.com 7f3c2a
```
